description:
Streaming structural-change pipeline service. Wires the corrcalc-lib online
        correlation engine to the graphs-algos-lib temporal change detector over one return
        stream per timescale, runs a per-asset alert layer, and publishes structural-change
        signals through a filter + multi-sink delivery seam. Validated by a pinned regression
        over eight historical crypto events. Consumes correlation matrices; produces signals —
        not a UI.
